relations: As air is blown into the bubble, its spherical surface expands outward from the fingertip contact point.
When the fingertip presses against the bubble's thin film, the film ruptures and the bubble collapses.
The bubble rests on the upright fingertip, maintaining contact until the puncturing motion begins.
caption: A bubble gum bubble is blown and then punctured using a finger.
